line.name: H. Upmann by AJ Fernandez
line.description: Not on the site. Launched by Altadis USA in 2017, a collaboration with A.J. Fernandez marking a departure from Upmann's traditional Dominican/mild profile toward a medium-to-full-bodied blend. Also marketed as 'H. Upmann Nicaragua by AJ Fernandez' / 'H. Upmann Crafted by AJ Fernandez.' FLAG: distinct from the separate 'H. Upmann Nicaragua AJ Fernandez Heritage' line (also researched in this batch) and from a newer Connecticut-wrapper spinoff called 'Sunrise' - these are different sub-lines under a broader 'by AJ Fernandez' family, not the same product.
line.binder: Corojo '99 (Nicaraguan) - one retailer (JR Cigars) instead lists 'Vintage San Andres,' possibly reflecting a blend refresh since 2017; not resolved
line.factory: Tabacalera A.J. Fernandez Cigars de Nicaragua, Esteli, Nicaragua

vitolas.name: Robusto
vitolas.notes: 2017 launch specs per Cigar Aficionado/Cigar Dojo. JR Cigars' current listing instead gives 5x54 - unresolved discrepancy, possibly a later resize.

vitolas.name: Toro
vitolas.notes: Matches the Mac photo, which is labeled simply 'Toro' - consistent with the 2017 launch specs (CA/Cigar Dojo). JR Cigars instead lists 6x50 for a Toro in this line - could not confirm which is correct without the actual band/box in hand.

vitolas.name: Churchill
vitolas.notes: 2017 launch specs. JR Cigars instead lists 7x52 and describes the line as having 4 vitolas without naming the 4th - unresolved.

research_notes: Vitola sizes conflict between 2017 trade-press launch coverage (treated as primary here) and current JR Cigars retail listings, which may reflect an unconfirmed blend/size refresh. A 4th vitola is implied by JR Cigars but not named - not added without a name. Gotham Cigars' page appears to conflate this line with the separate 'Heritage' line - not used as a source here to avoid cross-contamination.
